description: FULL BODY, head to toe. A 35-year-old Malaysian man with short, neat black hair, wearing a crisp, professional dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform including a peaked cap, silver badges, and polished black boots.
FULL BODY, head to toe. A 65-year-old Malaysian woman with a kind face, wearing a traditional floral print Baju Kurung with a matching light-colored hijab (tudung), and simple black sandals.

FULL BODY, head to toe. A 30-year-old Malaysian man with short black hair, wearing a smart-casual office outfit consisting of a light blue button-down shirt, dark grey slacks, and brown leather shoes.

FULL BODY, head to toe. An anonymous, featureless human silhouette made of dark shifting digital static, wearing a shadowy hooded jacket. Their face is a blank void with a faint blue glowing sound-wave pattern where a mouth would be.
